risk_score_source: Risk_score from the corrected v3 logistic reflection models; baseline uses low-confidence risk score.
acceptance_rule: Samples are accepted in ascending predicted error-risk order.
risk_definition: Cumulative classification errors divided by accepted samples.
aurc: Trapezoidal area under the risk-coverage curve.

bootstrap.sampling: Paired image-cluster bootstrap, stratified by OOF fold; image multiplicities shared across split seeds.
